⭐ Watchlist & IPO Watch

Question it answers: what should I buy this week from the things I am tracking, and what is about to list?

Tab id watchlist · loaders loadWatchlist() and loadIpo() · docs/js/watchlist.js, docs/js/drilldown.js, docs/js/ipo.js

Watchlist

Three sections (tabs .w-cats): 📈 Stocks · 🛢 Commodities · ₿ Crypto.

  • Search (any stock or ETF worldwide, e.g. Toyota, 0700.HK; crypto via Yahoo and Trading 212 ETPs; commodities via Trading 212 ETCs and market futures). Quick picks for commodities (Gold, Silver, Brent, WTI, Natural gas, Copper, Platinum, Wheat) and crypto (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, Cardano).
  • ☆ Bookmark an item to put it on the weekly plan. Each bookmarked item shows this week's call:
Call Meaning
🟢 ENTER Buy this week
🔵 ACCUMULATE Buy in steps
🟡 HOLD Wait for the price points
🔴 AVOID Not this week

together with price points with £ per step, how much to buy (worked out from the amount you type for that section: there is no fixed budget; with no amount entered the steps show "—"), RSI, volume and quality and an analyst chip (Yahoo Finance recommendation and number of analysts, or "no coverage"; never an invented rating). - Order flow (estimated): each stock card shows a chip (Large buyer / Large seller / Buyers leaning / Sellers leaning / Flow neutral, always marked "est.") and a line in Details. It is inferred from daily candles: volume at least 2.5× the stock's own 20-day average on a wide candle that closes in the top (or bottom) half of its range, within the last 5 sessions, plus 20-day volume-weighted close position. It is not real order flow: Yahoo's free data has no order book, tape or buy/sell split, so "buy orders of 20k lots" cannot be seen, and a fixed lot count would mean nothing across stocks (so the threshold is relative). It can only soften an ENTER to ACCUMULATE (large-seller footprint) or add a supporting line (large-buyer footprint); it never creates a buy and is shown beside, never blended into, the analyst consensus. With no volume or High/Low history it says nothing (unverified). Real block-trade / Level 2 data needs a licensed feed (backlog). - ✕ Remove stops all tracking of that item. - Drag to reorder: every card has a ⠿ handle on its left. Press it, drag the card up or down and let go (mouse or finger; the handle stops the page scrolling under your finger, and the list scrolls itself near the screen edge). While you drag, all cards fold to their headline so a long list is easy to cross. The new order is saved exactly like ▲ ▼ below. - ⇅ Arrange: tap it to move the cards of the current section (Stocks, Commodities or Crypto each have their own order). Cards turn into compact rows with big ▲ ▼ buttons (40 px, the first can't go up and the last can't go down); ✓ Done returns to the normal view and ↺ Automatic order puts the section back to this week's call. The order is saved to your login (a few taps in a row save once): in the private app it is a sort_order number inside your encrypted watchlist row, so the server never sees which tickers you watch or in what order (POST /watchlist/order is answered in the browser by docs/zk/shim.js); on the legacy page it is watchlist.sort_order (migration db/tenant/24_watchlist_order.sql, worker route /watchlist/order); the demo has no writable store, so the demo order is kept in that browser only. Cards you never arranged, including newly bookmarked ones, follow the arranged ones in the automatic order. Re-adding a ticker keeps its place. A failed save says so. - Tap a name for the full detail page: live chart (1D · 1W · 1M · 3M · 6M · 9M · 1Y · 5Y with 50/200-day moving averages; 3M and 9M are the last 63 / 189 daily closes of the 1-year chart), day and 52-week range, key stats, analyst rating and target, trading / profitability / leverage, company profile, insights and score radar, and this week's plan. Live prices use the /chart route (Yahoo Finance). - Prices from London lines quoted in pence are shown in pence. - Data: watchlist and watchlist_analysis (services/watchlist_service.py; private app: docs/zk/watchlist.js, watchlistops.js). There are no budget settings: the engines store only relative shares (weight.share per name, share per price point) and the dashboard multiplies them by the amount you enter above the list (Stocks, Commodities and Crypto each have their own box; it is not saved).

5-check review: every expanded stock card (analysed or "data unverified") ends with the same 🧪 5-check review box as the Strategy tab: your prompt with the stock's name and ticker filled in, buttons Copy prompt and ChatGPT · Claude · Grok (each opens that assistant's page with the prompt in the box), and Show the prompt. It is not run by CapitalLens and is not live data; see Strategy.

🚀 IPO Watch (card under the watchlist)

Works like the stock watchlist: nothing is listed until you bookmark it. The IPO calendar is only the thing you search.

  1. Search the calendar by company, ticker, sector, exchange or country name (for example Anthropic, Nasdaq, India). Several words narrow the result.
  2. Filter by country (chips: All countries, US, UK, India, HK, Other) and by exchange (dropdown built from the calendar). A filter on its own lists everything that matches.
  3. ☆ Bookmark a result. It appears under ⭐ My IPO list (and the result reads ★ In my list). Drag to reorder: with two or more IPOs each card has a ⠿ strip on its left edge (40 px wide, full card height). Press it and drag the card up or down (mouse or finger; the strip stops the page scrolling under your finger); the other cards fold to their headline while you drag and the list scrolls itself near the screen edge. Saved exactly like ▲ ▼ below. ⇅ Arrange (shown when the list has two or more IPOs) turns the list into compact numbered rows with big ▲ ▼ buttons (40 px; the first can't go up, the last can't go down); ✓ Done returns to the full cards and ↺ Automatic order goes back to phase-then-date. The order is saved to your login: a sort_order number inside your encrypted ipo_watch row (POST /ipo/order, answered in the browser by docs/zk/shim.js), so the server never sees which IPOs you follow or in what order. A few taps in a row save once; a failed save says so. IPOs you never arranged, including newly bookmarked ones, follow the arranged ones in the automatic order.
  4. ✕ on a card in My IPO list removes it (same ✕ as the stock watchlist, top right, 40px).
Element Detail
My IPO list Empty by default ("Nothing here yet. Search above, then tap ☆ Bookmark…"). Per-user, stored encrypted in the private app (ipo_watch)
Search results Shown only while a query or a filter is set, with a count; hidden when cleared
Each card Name, ticker, exchange, sector, status, rating pill (hover for source), Opens / Closes / Lists, price range or price, deal size, note, source link
Status (phase) open · closed · upcoming · priced · filed · rumoured · listed · postponed · withdrawn, derived from the dates
Legacy and demo dashboards Search and filters work; there is no per-user list, so no Bookmark buttons
  • Honest ratings: a rating other than Not rated must carry a rating_source; ratings are never invented. Today all rows are Not rated until a rating source is chosen.
  • Honest dates: an IPO whose price is not final says so in its note (for example "final price not confirmed").
  • Data: shared public table ipo_calendar (the searchable catalogue, nothing about any customer), upserted from config/ipo_calendar.json by services/ipo_service.py (workflow IPO Calendar, weekdays 06:15 UTC). There is no live exchange feed; the catalogue is curated JSON with a named source on every row.
  • Per-user list: routes POST ipo/watch and ipo/unwatch are answered in the browser by docs/zk/shim.js into the encrypted store (no database migration needed; enc_rows.kind = 'ipo_watch').

Tests

5-check box: tests/zk_fivecheck_test.mjs, tests/fivecheck_layout_test.py.

tests/zk_watchlist_order_test.mjs and tests/zk_ipo_order_test.mjs (arranging, drag strip markup, saving, encrypted rows), tests/ipo_watch_browser_test.py (real mouse drag, cancelled drag, touch drag, reload restores the order), tests/watchlist_order_layout_test.py (320/360/390px, buttons and handles ≥ 40 px, real taps, mouse and touch drags, cancelled drag), tests/zk_watchlist_test.mjs, tests/zk_watchlistops_test.mjs, tests/zk_ipo_test.mjs, tests/ipo_service_test.py, tests/ipo_layout_test.py (320/360/390px, every filter), tests/ipo_watch_browser_test.py (real typing, filters, bookmark, ✕).
